items.title: Citigroup (C) Enters Commerce Media With New Advertising Platform
items.summary: Citigroup (NYSE:C) introduced Citi Commerce Media, a new advertising and data platform targeting brands that want access to its U.S. cardholders. The bank plans to acquire rewards platform Kard to integrate its merchant and offer technology into Citi Commerce Media. Citi Commerce Media aims to use Citi's U.S. credit card transaction data to help advertisers reach consumers with more targeted campaigns. items.summary: Investing.com -- Citigroup (NYSE:C) is lining up major Wall Street banks for an initial public offering of Mexico’s Grupo Financiero Banamex that could raise more than $3 billion, Bloomberg reported exclusively, citing people familiar with the matter.
